mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation models and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), a core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% annually signals excessive inflation that may force the Fed to over-tighten, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 330,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 330,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals a supportive economic and monetary environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved consumer confidence and lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and falling FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (e.g., due to geopolitical events or natural disasters), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115.0 indicates reduced manufacturing output, which increases input costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO falls below 115.0 during a supply shock.
